Protocol support, bit-rate range, and MSA compliance apply to the whole family in TECHNICAL DATA (not per wavelength). `SO-SFP-10GE-LR40-Cxx` is omitted—no ordering row. No penalties were supplied. Receiver wavelength 1260–1620 nm and transmit 1271–1451 nm (G.694.2) apply to every SKU; center wavelength comes from the ordering description.

If the parser requires scalars only, say so and we can flatten (e.g. duplicate modes per protocol row where bit rate is explicit in the datasheet). Unused pool values `1260`, `1270`, `1450`, `1620` for min/max were not assigned per-channel—only `1271`/`1451` from the transmit and G.694.2 nominal band. `SO-SFP-10GE-LR40-Cxx` was skipped (family placeholder, no ordering row). `0.614` Gbps is only in the pool at product bit-rate range min, not tied to a named CPRI row (`CPRI Opt 1` is `0.6144`).
